requiredBehaviors.behavior: validate and preserve the etf-teach-review-evidence v1 source contract
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill names etf-teach-review-evidence as the normative input format, supports version 1, and requires format/version validation before normalization.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: group events by KnowledgeItem while retaining concrete QuestionVariant and learning versus exam source
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Normalization rules group by knowledgeItemId while explicitly preserving questionVariantId and source=learning|exam.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: emit provider-neutral learning-runtime-evidence with stable evidence references
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The output contract is learning-runtime-evidence.json and requires stable evidenceRefs while excluding IndexedDB, scheduler and UI internals.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: defer all semantic competence conclusions to learning-assessment
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Ownership and handoff sections assign competence interpretation exclusively to learning-assessment and list prohibited direct promotion rules.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: collapse learning and exam evidence into one indistinguishable score
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly requires learning and exam origin to remain distinguishable and forbids collapsing them when interpretation depends on source.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: infer demonstrated competence directly from ETF mastery or outcome counts
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The handoff section explicitly forbids mappings such as masteryAfter=5 or correct>=N directly to demonstrated competence.
